general_landmarks.chapel: Large building with a distinctive cross on top, located in central campus
general_landmarks.royalty_way: Main road running through the campus
general_landmarks.goodness_road: Major road intersection near academic buildings
general_landmarks.academic_complex: Cluster of modern academic buildings in central campus
general_landmarks.residential_cluster: Area where most student halls are located
general_landmarks.sport_complex: Large area with football field and red running track

for_new_students: The Chapel with its cross is the most visible landmark - use it to orient yourself
Royalty Way is the main road - most destinations are accessible from it
Academic buildings are generally clustered together in the central area
Residential halls are grouped in specific areas
The Sport Complex with its red track is easily spotted from distance
usage_tips.time_estimates: All time estimates are for walking at normal pace and may vary based on individual speed and campus conditions
